algorithm: Hash map plus sentinel doubly linked recency list; move hits and updates to newest, evict oldest on overflow.
complexity: get/put average O(1), constructor O(1), storage O(capacity). Mandatory bound preserved.
effects: Only receiver-owned map/list nodes mutate; no argument container mutation; get integer and put void. Independent receivers.
native_wrapper: Original official native interface, not solve equivalence or immutable observer qualification
qualification: unknown; candidate not executed; independent source/native observer review required
